notes.title: Atomic Heart 2 release date estimate, trailers, story, and gameplay
notes.notes:
When is the Atomic Heart 2 release date? Developer Mundfish is back, and wackier than ever. Atomic Heart was one of the most popular (and controversial) releases of 2023, presenting an alternate history 1950s Soviet Union dystopia that blends retrofuturism with surreal elements.

As one of the best FPS games, it has been quietly trucking along with a procession of DLC packs, and as we come to the end of its roadmap, Mundfish's Atomic Heart 2 announcement couldn't have come at a better time. To keep you up to speed, we've got all the latest news for the Atomic Heart 2 release date window, including gameplay trailers and story speculation.

notes.title: Atomic Heart 2 is keeping the "craziness," with even more horny robots
notes.notes:
I consider myself a bit of a shower philosopher. Some of the best articles I've ever written came to me during early morning steam sessions; it's where I ask myself questions and attempt to work out the answers. As a history and war studies graduate, I find my mind wandering to corners of the past: how would the world look if x had happened, instead of y? Mundfish answered one of those with Atomic Heart: what would have happened if the Soviet Union survived and became the global superpower? Apparently, lots of angry robots, fur people, and a very horny vending machine. But now, as revealed at Summer Game Fest, Atomic Heart 2 is on the horizon, seeking to answer different questions and ponder even more.
